title: Plant summary
subtitle: An area takes the colour of the worst status it contains. What could not be measured is counted apart, never as operational.

legend.title: How to read the colours
legend.hint: An area takes the WORST status it contains, not the average.
legend.coverage: A green area with low coverage is a planning problem, not a healthy area.

explain.title: How does this board work?
explain.what: Nobody creates it: it is computed from the latest reading of each machine in each service (vibration, thermography, ultrasound…). One tab per service.
explain.who: It changes every time someone saves a round, a visit or the record of values. That is why each area says which machine colours it, who measured it and when.
explain.read: An area's colour is the WORST state among its machines. Open an area to see its sectors and trains; a train's name opens its record of values.
explain.print: For a document handed to the customer there are MPd reports (per train and order, plus the monthly summary) and NDT reports.
